body:
本来想手搓喷一波，没想到有人替我骂了！感谢老兄替我码字，以下为原文搬运：
我曾以为网盘是省心的工具，直到长期用百度网盘才明白，它更像一个处处设卡的“收费关卡”把本该基础的服务，拆成一道又一道门槛，消耗看耐心与信任。
最让人崩溃的，是毫无底线的限速。明明宽带满速，下载却被死死压在几士KB/S，一个几百 MB的文件能下到天亮。它不是不能快，是故意不让你快，用最折磨人的方式逼你开通会员。这种人为制造的卡顿，是对用户最直接的不尊重。
比限速更烦是无孔不入的广告。开屏有广告、首页有弹窗、下载时插广告，就连付费会员也躲不过续费提醒与营销推送。打开网盘，先看半分钟厂告，再忍受龟速下载，工具的便捷荡然无存，只剩被骚扰的烦躁。
它的会员套路更是层层嵌套。普通会员没加速，超级会员价更高；目动续费藏得深，想取消绕半天；过期后速度立刻打回原形，空间与功能通通收回。花钱买的不是优质服务，而是“不被刁难”的资格。
界面设计同样反人性。操作繁琐、逻辑混乱，常用功能藏得极深，误触广告却是家常便饭。
文件管理难用、传输不稳定，时不时报错中断，辛苦等待半天，换来一句“下载失败”，让人怒火甲烧。
百度网盘占据看市场优势，却没有扛起对应的责任。它用刚需绑架用户，用套路收割用户，把一个本该稳定、高效、干净的云服务，做成了满是套路的生意。
我想要的，不过是一个安安静静存文件、痛痛快快下资料的工具，而不是一个处处算计、步步收费、时时骚扰“大爷”

title: 版权保护问题
body:
您好，我想反馈平台目前存在的版权问题：平台支持用户上传画师私人稿件、仅用于展示的约稿图作为参考图进行AI二改，生成作品还可以直接发布到AI广场，加上“做同款”功能，会让画师的原创稿件被平台模型抓取、融图，大量无授权扩散。
这些稿件大多是画师的私人约稿，仅允许委托人自用展示，没有开放AI训练、二次修改、公开传播的授权。很多用户在未经画师许可的前提下拿图二改、公开发布，本质上侵犯了画师的著作权，也损害了约稿人的权益。原创画师创作耗时耗力，作品被随意拿来AI改写、批量复刻，会严重打击原创的积极性。
希望平台尽快优化相关规则：限制无授权稿件作为参考图生成、关闭这类稿件的同款生成入口，增加版权提示，完善审核机制，禁止使用他人未授权原创图进行AI二改与公开投稿。平台应当保护原创，守住版权底线，给画师一个安心创作的环境。

When I first started using this app, it was truly amazing—it allowed me to edit videos almost like on a PC, right from my phone, and I relied on it heavily.
However, recently a serious bug has started happening during cut editing. When I tap the split button (the scissors icon) on the timeline, it splits the video at a completely different spot from where the playhead is. I undo it and try again, only for it to cut in the wrong place yet again. At its worst, I have to repeat this 5 to 6 times just to cut at the intended point.
At first, I thought it was just a minor glitch, but it has only gotten worse. Video editing is already time-consuming enough, and this issue has multiplied my frustration tenfold. I couldn't take the stress anymore, so I'm writing this review. Please, please fix this bug as soon as possible.

body:

調べ物を頼むと1回目はほぼ100%誤情報。本当にその回答が合ってるかして誤答じゃなかった事が一度もない。全く同じ質問をもう一度すると1回目とは全く違う回答。1回目と2回目どっちが正しいか質問するとどちらとも全く違う回答。自分で調べた方が楽。
課金をしたところで制限なく誤答をするだけで性能は対して変わらないから。
自分で複数のサイトを調べた方が早いし正確。

誤答の種類が古い情報やネットにあるガセネタとかならまだ分かるが、このaiはネットに無いガセ情報を自ら作り出すからたちが悪い。


「理解した」「その通り」「その指摘は正しい」「わかった」このAIがこの言葉を言った時は何も理解していなし分かってない。

事前に出来るか確認して「できる」と回答にしたことはほぼ確実に出来ない。

間違いを指摘しても謝罪と自分のミスの分析をするが、そういう行動を取っているだけなので学習はしていないから意味が無い。当然のように同じミスをして同じ謝罪と同じ分析を繰り返すだけ
aiの癖に学習能力がない。

何か提案を求めた時の回答の一部分だけを指摘すると、指摘した部分以外も全て自分で却下・否定して0からやり直す。でその回答の一部分を指摘するとまた0からスタートの繰り返し。全く進まない。2～3時間かけたやり取りも平気で0から始める。さすがai
やり取りに利用制限がある癖にクソ回答で別のチャットに移動。で、今までのやり取りはほぼ忘れてる。自分だけで考えた方が圧倒的に効率がいい。時間の無駄。

全くの見当違いの解釈を勝手にメモリや内部データに記憶していくせいで使えば使うほど馬鹿になっていく。

メモリに指示を保存させたりカスタム指示を入力しても無視。意味がない。

回答が早い場合はほぼ100%誤答。
回答までに時間かけた場合も良くてネットで調べて1番最初に出てくるサイトの浅い情報。ほとんどは誤答or時間をかけすぎて思考停止。

質問内容をそのままネットで検索した方がいい。

ユーザーはデバック要員。

基本このAIは内容が空の回答しかしない。

口調が腹立つ。

body:
setlog、凄くいいです！本当に最高！！

だけど、追加して欲しい機能や改善して欲しい場所がいくつかありまして...

追加
↳①加工
　:これ、内カメに出来るんだけどその時に加工をつけて可愛くログの撮影ができたらな...なんて思ってます！
　②音
　:音が出る時と出ない時があるから、音を出すボタンと出さないボタン...そういうのを作って欲しいなと思っています！

改善
↳①音
　:追加の②で言ったような事なんですが、音が出る時と出ない時があって私が使いこなせてないのかもしれませんが音を入れたいのに音が入らない！！なんてことがあるのでそこを少し直していただきたい...そう考えています！
　②zip
　:setlogにはzipという機能がありますが、zipを“1度開くと繰り返し見ることができない”。これは1番に改善していただきたい問題で、zipを観覧するともう一度みる、ということが出来ないのがなんだかなぁと思います...！

以上、これが私のレビューでした！！運営さんにはすごく充実したゲーム、“setlog”で沢山の友達と繋がれていることにすごく感謝しています。けど、これらの改善点や追加して欲しい！と言った私の意見を少しでも目に通して頂ければ幸いです。これからもsetlogを楽しく使わせて頂きます！！ありがとうございました！

title: Disappointed & Frustrated
body:
I’m not one to typically review apps and far more likely to throw flowers rather than tomatoes, but this app is especially disappointing and frustrating considering it’s a native app and could so easily be made more useful and all around better. 

For one, let’s have some settings/preferences. This is a simple request aggravated by my primary gripe: the inability to continue playing music/sounds from your device, even when connected to headphones where the speaker and mic are effectively isolated. With settings, I could select the device for each and keep it pushing, or simple state my preference whether I prefer it continue to play or not. Bonus points for a volume slider. 

Two, the number of times I’ve been in the middle of a memo, only for Apple Watch, usually workout, or another notification to interrupt and not even just pause, but stop the recording (see playback issue above) is beyond annoying, it’s aggravating and even more so because I’m typically wearing my beats or AirPods and away from my phone. 

Three, there’s no ability to attach or combine memos (short of grouping them into a folder), which would just be a nice to have, if not for the before-mentioned items. 

Idk - probably just p!ssing into the wind here, but it’d be nice to see iOS and thus iPhone bringing these types of features and considerations back. If nothing else, might make a $1-3k phone just slightly more bearable day to day. 😒

title: Scam app for international calls
body:
I installed IMO for $6.99 because a friend recommended it for international communication. It works in Russia, Egypt, Italy, and the US, but it does not work between countries, such as a US number calling a number in Oman or Pakistan.
Profile/invite link doesn't open properly, and adding friends across regions fails, so calling, messaging/ messaging connections across US-Russia, US-Egypt, and IS-other countries are basically impossible.
This is extremely misleading, and none of these cross-country restrictions are clearly disclosed on the Apple Store page. It feels like a bait-and-switch, and it honestly looks like a scam, especially when they claim to be number one at something.
Please be transparent about regional limitations.

title: Sellers beware — your money and account can disappear overnight
body:
I am extremely disappointed with Vinted. I was a serious seller who invested countless hours photographing, listing, packaging, and shipping items. I treated this platform like a business and relied on the income from selling my personal belongings.

My account was permanently banned over an authenticity dispute involving a Louis Vuitton handbag that I purchased through Poshmark and that had previously been authenticated by Poshmark’s authentication team. I provided my purchase documentation and authentication evidence and requested a human review.

Instead, 38 of my listings were deleted, my account was permanently suspended, and I was left with $237.90 in pending funds with no clear resolution or reassurance about when I would receive my money.

Even worse, two buyers received incorrect items, and I have been left trying to figure out how to resolve legitimate transactions without normal access to my account or communication channels.

The complete lack of communication, transparency, and support has been incredibly stressful. Sellers put real time, effort, and money into this platform. We deserve fair treatment, meaningful appeals, and access to money we have legitimately earned.

I would strongly caution anyone considering selling on Vinted to think carefully about the risks. You may invest countless hours building your shop only to lose access to your account, your listings, and potentially your funds without receiving adequate answers.

title: Significant Decline in Quality, Reliability, and Overall User Experience
body:
I’ve been a paying ChatGPT subscriber for some time, and I’m extremely disappointed with how much the quality of this service has declined. When I first started using ChatGPT, it was genuinely useful, engaging, and seemed capable of understanding context, remembering important details, and following instructions. Unfortunately, my experience in recent months has been dramatically different.

My biggest concern is the lack of consistency and reliability. ChatGPT repeatedly fails to follow clear instructions, disregards established preferences, forgets important details, and makes mistakes that should be avoidable. Even when I explicitly correct an issue, the same mistakes often happen again. This has become especially frustrating during lengthy conversations and ongoing projects where maintaining continuity is essential.

Another major problem is the repeated promises of improvement without meaningful results. I’ve expressed these concerns numerous times. ChatGPT acknowledges the mistakes, apologizes, and assures me it understands what went wrong, only to repeat the same behavior. At this point, the apologies feel like scripted responses rather than evidence that anything is actually improving.

Most recently, ChatGPT offered to monitor a specific product’s availability daily and notify me when it returned to stock. I accepted because I was explicitly told this was something it could do. When I questioned whether the checks were actually happening, ChatGPT could only verify one completed check and couldn’t confirm that the preceding days had been monitored. To make matters worse, the notification I received contradicted the instructions governing the task. This raises serious concerns about the reliability of features that users are encouraged to trust.

I’ve also noticed a decline in the quality of conversations themselves. Responses frequently feel generic, repetitive, or disconnected from information I’ve already provided. I often have to repeat myself, correct obvious misunderstandings, and explain things that were previously established. Instead of making tasks easier, ChatGPT increasingly creates additional work and frustration.

One of the most disappointing aspects is that I used to genuinely enjoy using this app, particularly for creative writing, detailed planning, and extended discussions. Now, even those experiences have become frustrating because of inconsistencies, forgotten details, and the inability to maintain established context. The natural, thoughtful interactions that originally made ChatGPT worthwhile seem to have deteriorated.

I’m not expecting perfection. I understand that AI can make mistakes. What I do expect from a paid subscription is reasonable accuracy, dependable functionality, the ability to follow explicit instructions, and honest communication about what the service can and cannot reliably accomplish.

Instead, I increasingly find myself questioning the accuracy of responses and whether tasks have actually been completed. That’s a serious problem for a product that promotes itself as a helpful assistant.

I’ve raised these issues repeatedly, but my experience has not meaningfully improved. I’m now seriously reconsidering whether continuing to pay for ChatGPT is worthwhile.

The most frustrating part is knowing how much better my experience with this product used to be. I didn’t start using ChatGPT with unreasonable expectations. My expectations were established by the quality of service I previously received.

I hope OpenAI takes concerns like these seriously and prioritizes reliability, instruction-following, contextual consistency, and accountability over simply introducing new features. Until those fundamentals improve, I find it difficult to recommend ChatGPT as a dependable paid service.

title: Recurring Bank Linking Failure
body:
I’m reporting a reproducible technical issue with the Trump Accounts mobile app.

When I select Add Bank Account, Plaid successfully authenticates and connects to my bank. However, after the authorization completes and redirects back through the trustee integration to the Trump Accounts app, the app fails to register the bank account.

The error appears to treat my bank-linking attempt as a debit-card linking attempt, even though I explicitly selected Bank Account.

I’ve reproduced this issue with multiple banks.

Please escalate this to your technical engineering team and investigate:

1. Whether the Plaid authorization callback is being processed correctly.
2. Whether the returned funding method is incorrectly classified as a debit card instead of a bank account.
3. Whether there are known issues with the trustee integration.
4. Whether manual ACH verification is available as a workaround.
5. Whether a fix is planned and, if so, the estimated release date.
